QUICK READ / CABINS & PRIVACY

Luxury CEO office design ideas to elevate your leadership style.

Plan for the work, not just the title on the door.

Three ideas to take into your workplace conversation.

01 / 03

List the activities inside

An enclosed room may need to support focused work, confidential calls, short meetings and occasional presentations. Prioritise the actual mix before choosing the desk and storage.

Next idea ↓
02 / 03

Balance enclosure and connection

Position doors and glazing with attention to privacy and the wider office. Visual openness does not automatically provide speech privacy; review acoustic requirements separately.

Next idea ↓
03 / 03

Test furniture as a setting

Draw the desk chair in use, visitor seats pulled out and cupboard doors open. These checks expose conflicts that a neat furniture outline can hide.

Put it in your brief ↗
A PRACTICAL TAKEAWAY

Before you decide.

  • Agree the real purpose and occupancy of the room.
  • Check speech privacy and glare on screens.
  • Test furniture access and daily movement.
